patch.summary:
Choose Livestorm only if your buying job matches “Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than Livestorm's shape. Workflow advantage: Livestorm leans multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing; Uniqode leans content-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Livestorm is Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.; Uniqode is Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR; paid dynamic from researched ~$9/mo floor..
- Company-size focus: Livestorm (small-business, mid-market) vs Uniqode (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Livestorm-leaning multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing vs Uniqode-leaning content-marketing.
- Researched limits: Livestorm — Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Uniqode — Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — Livestorm: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Pro caps session length at 4 hours (12 on Enterprise); Uniqode: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite; Plan cards hard to verify without live checkout.
